Author: chobab
Description:
[quote]Feel free to edit, recolor, and redesign as you like. You're also welcome to redistribute — just make sure to credit me![/quote]
[b][center][size=5]<How to Install>[/size][/center][/b]
[b]Required Mods:[/b]
There are two options for installation:
[list=1]
[*][b]CP Version[/b] (can be animated with SpaceCore):
[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SpaceCore (optional)
[/list]
[*][b]AT Version[/b]:
[list]
[*]Alternative Texture
[/list][/list]
[b]Ream Me:
[/b]1. After installing the required mods, simply unzip this retexture mod into your Mods folder.
2. For CP ver
By default, building animations are enabled, and they require SpaceCore.
If you set "Animation": false in the config file, animations will be disabled, and you can still use the retexture with only Content Patcher.

+The well design was inspired by the Infused-water dispenser from Animal Crossing.

+ 250323
Added an option for a yellow roof farmhouse!
